jobs.name: feature-explore-celtic
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished painterly fantasy game illustration for a Pantheon Realms website feature card, matching a premium mythological strategy game. Portrait 3:4, 1086 by 1448 if possible. Readable stylized forms, rich atmospheric depth, beautifully hand-painted game art, not photorealism. Main storytelling in upper two thirds. Lower quarter should be quieter, dark and low contrast for HTML text overlay. Full bleed, no borders, no text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark. Only the specified pantheon's visual identity; do not mix Greek/Roman elements into these scenes. Theme: EXPLORE, CELTIC pantheon. A green-cloaked Celtic mounted scout with copper hair, leather tack and a round knotwork shield pauses on an elevated forest trail, viewing a lush emerald valley. The road winds toward an ancient standing-stone circle, an enormous sacred oak, a river crossing and a distant timber settlement. Ferns, mossy stones and misty wooded hills. Warm shafts of sunrise through the canopy, bronze and emerald accents. Make the horse, scout, winding path and discovery of the standing stones unmistakable. No marble classical temples, pyramids or samurai.
